install_params.name: repository
install_params.label: Repository
install_params.description: The repository holding sources/*.yml — the agent branches from its main and opens the pull request there.

install_params.name: cronExpression
install_params.label: Schedule
install_params.description: Cron expression, UTC. Off the hour, so the run does not queue behind every other daily job.

install_params.name: machineType
install_params.label: Runner fleet
install_params.description: A fleet whose machines have claude, git, gh, ssh, curl and the Go toolchain.

install_params.name: prodSshHost
install_params.label: Production SSH host
install_params.description: user@host of the machine running the production database. The contribution table lives only there.

install_params.name: prodDbName
install_params.label: Database name
install_params.description: Database queried over that SSH connection as the postgres user.

install_params.name: sshSecret
install_params.label: SSH private key
install_params.description: Secret holding the private key under the key private_key. Give it the narrowest account that can read link_contributions and flip its status.

install_params.name: telegramChatId
install_params.label: Telegram chat
install_params.description: Where the run reports. Negative for groups and channels; the bot has to be a member already.

install_params.name: gitUserName
install_params.label: Commit author name
install_params.description: Author on the commits the run pushes.

install_params.name: gitUserEmail
install_params.label: Commit author email
install_params.description: Author email on those commits. Commits are signed off with it, so use an address the project accepts for DCO.
